observations.note: The agent skipped the step 7 check of specs that the changed source file touches and admitted it in the final message, so a falsified spec behaviour could go unflagged.
Step 8 asks for one edit of the plan marking all rows, but the agent made a failed edit and then three separate edits, one per row.
One Edit failed on a string mismatch and the marks were then applied in repeated single-row edits to the same file instead of one combined edit.

conformance.item: Step 1: read plan rows and triage note
Step 3: write tests first and see them fail
Step 6: run only the test files the rows name
Step 7: check specs touched by the changed source file
Step 8: write completed marks in one edit
Limits: no git commit, push or gh
